scope: Read-only comparison of the sealed before projection, qualified-source-scope implementation, independent source-question interpretation, and targeted regression tests. No source application, generated handoff refresh, code edit, or seal update was performed.

review.antiwaiver: The projection derives questions from finding.kind === unresolved-source-scope, not qualified status or optional finding metadata. It forces question status to unresolved and semanticPass to false, while recording qualification as extractionRepresentation. The fixture regression mutates finding.underlyingSourceQuestion and finding.semanticPass to resolved/true and still gets both open questions.
review.deletion: The presentation rejects a missing question array, a deleted question, a resolved question, or a wrong affected-row count. The separate sealed-register validator and its tests reject omission of a sealed finding extension or uncertainty register, and reject substitution of sealed bytes. These checks guard presentation deletion and active registry omission respectively.
review.separation: The two underlying source questions remain separate from the eight retained-register records. The existing UA note applicability/glyph review remains separately qualified; neither its note-link count nor its glyph holds are folded into the monetary source-question count.
review.nonclaims: The output preserves semanticPass=false, sourceAbsence=false, and general source review pending. Its description states that the review does not establish complete source coverage and that open questions do not establish missing source material.
